CustomField.description:
Formula field used to display the Contract Renewal Quarter
Case/Ticket: #00016910
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Contract_End__c), "-", "'" & RIGHT( TEXT( YEAR(Contract_End__c) ), 2 ) & " " & "Q" & TEXT( CEILING( MONTH(Contract_End__c) / 3 ) ) )
CustomField.label: Contract Renewal Quarter
